def check_girth_fast(edges, n, min_girth):
    """Check if graph has girth at least min_girth using BFS."""
    adj = {i: set() for i in range(n)}
    for u, v in edges:
        adj[u].add(v)
        adj[v].add(u)

        dist = {start: 0}

                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                    parent[v] = u
                    queue.append(v)
                elif v != parent[u] and dist[v] >= dist[u]:

    return True
